verdict.rationale: Mercury's own marketing claims "granular user permissions" alongside card limits and spend controls (mercury-docs-10), and says built-in permissions let an accountant make payments (mercury-docs-11). That is a first-party user-permission capability, but it is described only in one-line marketing copy with no detail on roles or scoping. Scoped API tokens are API access controls, not team-member roles, so they earn no credit here. missing for 10: documented role definitions and permission matrix, scoping of permissions by location or department, admin documentation of role assignment, independent or hands-on corroboration.
